BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION)

CLASS: IMSC   SEMESTER: VI
BRANCH: MATHS & COMPUTING  SESSION : SP/2020

SUBJECT : CS4109 COMPUTER SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE

TIME: 1.5  HOURS   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The total marks of the questions are 30.
2. Candidates may attempt for all 30 marks.
3. In those cases where the marks obtained exceed 25 marks, the excess will be ignored.
4. Before attempting the question paper, be sure that you have got the correct question paper.
5. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------



Q1 (a) How design procedure & performance of the computer changes with time? [2]
 (b) Suppose  we  have  two  implementations  of  the  same  instruction  set  architecture.
Computer  A  has  a  clock  cycle  time  of  250  ps  &  a  CPI  of  2.0  for  some  program,  and
computer B has a clock cycle time of 500 ps & a CPI of 1.2 for the same program. Which
computer is faster for this program & by how much?
[3]


Q2 (a) Why have been computer designed to use the binary number system? [2]
 (b) Carry out the following conversions:
(1011011)
2
  (              )
10
       (               )
8
      (              )
16

[3]


Q3 (a) Give behavioral description of a full adder. Also draw the truth table. [2]
 (b) Define an encoder. Explain Octal to Binary Encoder. [3]


Q4 (a) What are the important elements of bus design? [2]
 (b) What is an interrupt? How is it executed? Show the program flow with interrupts. [3]


Q5 (a) Differentiate between combinational and sequential circuits. [2]
 (b) Perform  (11011)
2
 – (10011)
2
 [3]


Q6 (a) Draw the flowchart for floating point addition of 2 numbers.  [2]
 (b) What decimal number is represented by this single precision float:
11000000101000000000000000000000
[3]

context.
[2]
 (b) What is HDL? Write an HDL program for 8-bit binary multiplication. [3]

Q2 (a) What are the major component types at register level design?  [2]

 (b) How the fixed-point numbers represented in the computer system?  [3]

[2]

[3]
